name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v533: Fixed the WebView solving 2-3 extra times after verification. Two causes: (1) saving waited for the page title to stop saying 'Just a moment', which lags behind the cf_clearance cookie, so Cloudflare reloaded and re-solved - clearance now saves the moment it appears (the jar is purged before every solve, so a clearance seen at that point is fresh); (2) a second solver could start while the sheet was open - playback's probe was throttled out, then CloudflareKiller's init wiped the shared cookie jar and destroyed the clearance just earned. In-flight bypass solves are now joined instead of raced. All v532 features retained: real cookie validation on app open and before playback, real-sized invisible WebView behind app content on TV, all-host cookie save, visible-sheet fallback, no buttons, invisible default.
